## Featured work

### [SpeakBetter AI](https://github.com/Kesavamoorthig06/speak-better-ai)

An AI-powered public speaking coach that analyzes delivery quality through voice, video, and presentation signals.

- Eye contact analysis
- Speech clarity and pacing metrics
- Filler word tracking
- Feedback reports for improvement
